newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's August diamond exports up at $196 mln.
newsitem.headline: Israel's August diamond exports up at $196 mln.

text.p: Israel's net exports of polished diamonds in August rose to $196 million from $178 million in August 1995, the Ministry of Industry and Trade said.
Since the beginning of the year net exports of polished diamonds rose to $2.583 billion from $2.539 billion a year earlier.
Exports of uncut diamonds in the first eight months rose to $458 million from $447 million in the year-earlier period.
The United States accounted for 44 percent of Israel's diamond exports while Japan accounted for 18 percent and Hong Kong 17 percent.
The ministry's supervisor of diamonds Zafrir Anbar said August is usually a month of slow sales as the sector takes collective holiday.
